statement: For the CM-stable fibre product G_Q times_E G_(beta Q), Hom(G,Gm)=0 and End(G) tensor Q=Q(beta). An explicit algebraic antisymmetric compact lift and a hypothetical diagonal compact lift isolate the Gaussian in the minus-beta Lie eigencoordinate; no algebraic quasi-endomorphism or rational polynomial limit realizes that projector.
depends_on: C.7.1; C.7.2; C.7.6; C.7.9; analytic subgroup theorem
notes: Exact CM matrix and projector displayed; approximation has uniform spectral error at least 1/2. The missing step is algebraicity of the projected exponential, not existence of the Lie projector.
